nodes.description: uint8[] private data; holds the pixel color index array of the artwork
string public title of the artwork
string private dataURI used as the base token URI
uint32 public immutable width of the image
uint32 public immutable height of the image
uint8[C][] private palette of RGB color entries
uint256 public immutable auctionStart block number
uint256 public immutable auctionEnd block number gating participation
uint256 public immutable minimum initial bid for a pixel
mapping(uint256 => uint256) private pixelPrice; last price paid per pixel
address immutable devAddress set to the deployer (msg.sender)
bool public auctionStarted flag locking the original image
constructor initializing width, height, palette, title, auction window, devAddress and data array
payable buyPixel(x,y,colorIndex) guarded by isAvailable and nonReentrant; pays out previous owner and dev then transfers the NFT
changeColor(x,y,colorIndex) lets the pixel owner recolor during the auction
setImage(ColorMap[]) onlyOwner isAvailable sets the original image before the auction starts
getImage() view returns the row-major uint8[] RGB image
getData() view returns the raw color index array
getPalette() view returns the palette
hasEnded() view returns block.number > auctionEnd
getPixelPrice(pixelId) view returns minInitialBid or double the last price
_setColor(pixelId,colorIndex) internal validates palette index and writes into data
_getId(x,y) public view validates bounds and computes y*width+x
_ownerOf(pixelId) public view returns owner or address(0)
overridden safeTransferFrom requiring hasEnded then delegating to super
overridden transferFrom requiring hasEnded then delegating to super
setDataURI(string) onlyOwner sets the base token URI
_baseURI() internal view override returns dataURI
_send(address,uint256) internal low-level call{value:} forwarding Ether to a caller-influenced address
ERC721 _safeMint triggers onERC721Received on the receiving contract
ERC721 _safeTransfer triggers onERC721Received on the receiving contract
msg.sender / _msgSender(): external caller, token recipient, dev and bidder address
block.number (block-level timing) used for auctionStart, auctionEnd and hasEnded gating
x coordinate parameter of buyPixel
y coordinate parameter of buyPixel
colorIndex parameter of buyPixel
x coordinate parameter of changeColor
y coordinate parameter of changeColor
colorIndex parameter of changeColor
ColorMap[] colors parameter of setImage
_to recipient parameter of _send
_value amount parameter of _send
_dataURI string parameter of setDataURI
from parameter of safeTransferFrom
to parameter of safeTransferFrom
tokenId parameter of safeTransferFrom
_data bytes parameter of safeTransferFrom
local pixelId computed in buyPixel
local currentOwner of the pixel in buyPixel
local minPrice = pixelPrice[pixelId]*2 in buyPixel
local payout = (msg.value*4)/5 sent to the previous owner
local pixelId computed in changeColor
local image array assembled in getImage

edges.reason: constructor writes auctionStart = block.number
constructor writes auctionEnd = block.number + _auctionDuration, which gates all auction functions
constructor sets devAddress = msg.sender (deployer) as immutable payout recipient
constructor allocates the data array of size width*height
constructor assigns width
constructor assigns height
constructor assigns palette
constructor assigns minInitialBid
msg.sender is the mint/transfer recipient and ownerOf comparison in buyPixel, giving the caller control over reentrant receivers
changeColor compares _msgSender() against ownerOf(pixelId)
constructor stores msg.sender as devAddress, permanently controlling payout destination
isAvailable gates buyPixel via require(block.number <= auctionEnd)
isAvailable gates changeColor via block.number <= auctionEnd
isAvailable gates setImage via block.number <= auctionEnd
hasEnded reads block.number against auctionEnd
safeTransferFrom override requires hasEnded() which depends on block.number
transferFrom override requires hasEnded() which depends on block.number
buyPixel finally writes pixelPrice[pixelId] = msg.value
buyPixel sets auctionStarted = true on first purchase
buyPixel requires msg.value >= minInitialBid for unminted pixels
buyPixel writes the chosen color into data through _setColor
getPixelPrice returns pixelPrice[pixelId]*2
getPixelPrice returns minInitialBid when the pixel does not exist
hasEnded reads the auctionEnd state variable
setDataURI (onlyOwner) writes the dataURI state variable
_baseURI returns the dataURI state variable
_setColor writes data[pixelId] = colorIndex
_setColor validates colorIndex < palette.length
_getId requires x < width
_getId requires y < height
getImage reads the palette for each pixel
getImage reads data via _getId
getData returns the data array
getPalette returns the palette
_ownerOf checks ERC721 ownership of the pixel
buyPixel calls _send to pay the previous owner and the dev before updating pixelPrice
buyPixel calls _safeMint(msg.sender, pixelId) for a new pixel
buyPixel calls _safeTransfer to move the NFT to the new owner
buyPixel calls _setColor to store the chosen color
setImage loops calling _setColor for each ColorMap entry
setImage calls _getId for each entry
getImage calls _getId while iterating over the image
buyPixel computes pixelId via _getId
changeColor computes pixelId via _getId
safeTransferFrom override requires hasEnded before delegating to super
transferFrom override requires hasEnded before delegating to super
safeTransferFrom delegates to super which calls _safeTransfer and thus the receiver callback
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the receiving contract controlled by msg.sender
_safeTransfer invokes onERC721Received on the receiving contract controlled by msg.sender
_send forwards Ether with a low-level call to a caller-influenced address, enabling a fallback reentry
the low-level _send executes before pixelPrice/state effects, so a malicious recipient may reenter buyPixel (mitigated by nonReentrant)
x parameter feeds buyPixel
y parameter feeds buyPixel
colorIndex parameter feeds buyPixel
x parameter feeds changeColor
y parameter feeds changeColor
colorIndex parameter feeds changeColor
colors array parameter feeds setImage
_to recipient parameter flows into the low-level call in _send
_value amount parameter flows into the low-level call in _send
_dataURI parameter flows into setDataURI
from parameter feeds safeTransferFrom
to parameter feeds safeTransferFrom
tokenId parameter feeds safeTransferFrom
_data bytes parameter feeds safeTransferFrom
pixelId local is assigned from _getId in buyPixel
pixelId is used as index for existence checks, price and NFT operations in buyPixel
currentOwner is passed as the recipient of the low-level _send payout
minPrice = pixelPrice[pixelId]*2 is the required bid in buyPixel
payout = (msg.value*4)/5 is forwarded via the low-level _send to the previous owner
pixelId local is computed and used in changeColor
image local buffer is filled and returned by getImage

normalization_plan.reason: x coordinate parameter is only consumed by buyPixel to compute pixelId via _getId
y coordinate parameter is only consumed by buyPixel to compute pixelId via _getId
colorIndex parameter of buyPixel is only forwarded to _setColor
x coordinate parameter is only consumed by changeColor
y coordinate parameter is only consumed by changeColor
colorIndex parameter of changeColor is only forwarded to _setColor
colors array parameter is only iterated inside setImage
_to recipient parameter is only used as the low-level call target of _send
_value parameter is only used as the Ether amount of the low-level call in _send
_dataURI parameter is only assigned to the dataURI state variable by setDataURI
from parameter is only forwarded to super.safeTransferFrom in the override
to parameter is only forwarded to super.safeTransferFrom in the override
tokenId parameter is only forwarded to super.safeTransferFrom in the override
_data bytes parameter is only forwarded to super.safeTransferFrom in the override
pixelId local is transient inside buyPixel and drives its existence check, pricing and NFT operations
currentOwner local is only read to become the payout recipient of the low-level _send call
minPrice local is only used for the require check inside buyPixel
payout local is only computed to be transferred through the low-level _send call
pixelId local is transient inside changeColor and drives its ownership check
image local buffer is created and returned solely inside getImage
